input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position: no non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant binds the Customer (or either Party) anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for the rule's detection terms — "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "poach", "hire", "employ", "personnel", "staff" and "shall not" — return only indemnity references to third parties "hired by, employed, retained or under" a Party's control (p0051, p0052), confidentiality handling by employees and directors (p0056, p0061), authorized-personnel data access controls (p0035, p0045), and the independent-contractor / no-agency clause quoted above (p0066), which imposes no hiring or solicitation restriction. The deterministic checks for a 12-month duration limit and a general-solicitation carve-out therefore fail only because there is no restrictive covenant to measure; their failure does not indicate a deviation. Because the preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit on the Customer, no redline is proposed and the text is left unchanged. Internal note for negotiation: if the Vendor later introduces a non-solicit, we hold it to the fallback — mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire; a no-hire or a restriction exceeding 24 months or covering all Vendor personnel is walk-away.
